# JK Gray Linux

An Arch-based operating system for penetration testing and security research.

- [Manual (nur Deutsch)](../jk-arch-installer/manual.md)

## Overview

Over 3000 security tools across approximately 50 categories. Built on Arch Linux and BlackArch. Custom Hyprland desktop with optimized builds and LLVM compilation.

Designed for experienced users, reverse engineering, binary exploitation and advanced security research. Not for beginners.

## Installation

Minimal setup. Works on Arch-based distributions including CachyOS, EndeavourOS and Bazzite. VM testing via QEMU or VirtualBox supported.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/17jk789/dots-hyprland.git
cd dots-hyprland
./setup install
```

## Roadmap

First official release planned mid-2027. Currently in active development. Some features are experimental. Bug reports and contributions welcome.
